reason: A WeChat iLink bridge that connects incoming and outgoing WeChat text messages with DeepSeek Harness agent sessions, with web configuration, access controls, QR login, session management, and credential renewal.

summaries.zh: 将微信 iLink 消息接入 DeepSeek Harness 智能体会话，并提供扫码登录、会话管理、权限配置和自动续期功能。
summaries.en: Connects WeChat iLink messages to DeepSeek Harness agent sessions with QR login, session management, permission settings, and automatic credential renewal.

capabilities: Bridges WeChat messages to DeepSeek Harness agent sessions
Sends agent replies and proactive notifications to WeChat
Provides QR-code login and stores service credentials
Provides web-based model, permission, and session configuration
Uses long polling to receive messages and automatic credential renewal
